visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a yellow flower crown and a fringed yellow jacket holds a small clear glass containing a brown liquid. She is outdoors in a crowded square at night with historical buildings in the background. She smiles, looks at the camera, and drinks the liquid. (2) The camera pans to show a massive crowd of people in a plaza, many wearing yellow hats or crowns, holding up their smartphones. In the background, a large colonial-style cathedral is visible under the night sky. (3) The woman holds her phone high to capture the fireworks exploding in the dark sky above the cathedral. She is screaming with excitement, her mouth wide open, her face full of joy. (4) Several people in the crowd turn to her; she is hugged by a woman and then a man who gives a thumbs up. They are all smiling and celebrating. (5) She begins eating green grapes rapidly from a small plastic bag. She looks directly at the camera while chewing enthusiastically. (6) She continues the ritual of eating grapes while more fireworks burst in the sky behind her. The crowd around her is jumping and cheering. (7) She throws the empty plastic bag into the air with a celebratory gesture. (8) The final shots show wide views of the crowded plaza filled with thousands of people and bright fireworks lighting up the sky over the historic church architecture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 跟台灣13小時差的秘魯 跨年怎麼過. [Variety]: POV. (2) [Slogan]: 完全聽不懂的倒數. (3) [Slogan]: 別人尖叫我也尖叫 Happy New Year. (4) [Slogan]: 旁邊陌生人抱我慶祝. (5) [Slogan]: 她教我先咬肉桂棒在吃葡萄. (6) [Slogan]: 新年吃下12顆葡萄. (7) [Slogan]: 邊吃邊許願. (8) [Slogan]: 單身的吃可以脫單. (9) [Slogan]: 拼命的吃可以招財. (10) [Slogan]: 2025 一切順利順心. [Variety]: Happy New Year.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, dozens of identifiable people in the square, and a massive background crowd.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a vibrant yellow flower crown and a mustard-yellow jacket with colorful fringes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A large historic town square (Plaza de Armas) featuring a massive colonial cathedral with twin towers, lit by streetlights and fireworks. The square is densely packed with people.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy hum of a massive crowd. A female voice speaks excitedly in Mandarin, her pitch high and tone animated. (2) A series of loud, percussive explosions from fireworks begin, creating sharp transients that dominate the mix. The woman screams 'Happy New Year!' with intense vocal strain and high arousal. (3) Background music with a rhythmic electronic beat is faintly audible behind the roar of the crowd. (4) Shouts in Spanish and English from surrounding people mix with the woman's laughter. The sound of her chewing grapes and the rustle of a plastic bag are clearly audible during brief lulls in the firework noise. (5) The recording ends with a continuous wall of sound consisting of cheering, whistling, and rapid-fire pyrotechnic impacts, maintaining a peak level of acoustic dynamism.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the high-energy experience of celebrating New Year's Eve in Peru, highlighting unique local traditions such as eating 12 grapes for luck and wearing yellow items in a massive public gathering.
